edits.label: about
edits.find:
About this Calculator

This calculator breaks your Annual CTC into Basic, HRA, Special Allowance, PF contributions and Professional Tax to estimate your monthly and annual in-hand (take-House) salary. Employer PF is part of your CTC but not part of your gross salary or take-House pay.
